overview: You shut the chronicle. Gib got onto the cover, and you left him there. The new line was still wet. The share sat beside the book, and you did not count the chest.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Shut the book, left the cat, and left the chest uncounted.

assets.name: Holinshed
assets.disposition: Shut the chronicle and kept Gib on the cover

summary: Shut the chronicle and kept Gib on the cover
